title: Troy Aikman engages in potential pre-tampering with Kyle Shanahan

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Troy Aikman engages in potential pre-tampering with Kyle Shanahan
sources.description: If Troy Aikman exits broadcasting after this season (last month, he put the chance at "50-50") and if Aikman lands a key position in a front office, the name at the top of his head-coaching wishlist will already be known.
